LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO INTEGRATED SCIENCE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Scientific Investigation
Topic 1.1: Introduction to Integrated Science

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Introduction to Integrated Science. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How is the knowledge acquired in Integrated Science useful in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the importance of science in daily life
2. show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: INTRODUCTION TO INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Introduction to Integrated Science helps you succeed in INTEGRATED SCIENCE. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: INTRODUCTION TO INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Study Introduction to Integrated Science like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the importance of science in daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the importance of science in daily life. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the importance of science in daily life.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Introduction to Integrated Science” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the importance of science in daily life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school

What this means
In this part you learn to show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Introduction to Integrated Science matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Introduction to Integrated Science is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Introduction to Integrated Science” around your school. (skill: explain the importance of science in daily life)

Example 2: Say why Introduction to Integrated Science matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Introduction to Integrated Science to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the importance of science in daily life.
3. Practise this skill: show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Introduction to Integrated Science from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Introduction to Integrated Science: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Introduction to Integrated Science?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the knowledge acquired in Integrated Science useful in daily life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Introduction to Integrated Science means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the importance of science in daily life.
5. Be able to: show interest in learning Integrated Science at junior school.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
